place: Plai Laem, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Fully Staffed Oceanfront Six-Bedroom Villa with Pool, Cinema & Gym
note: Villa manager, chef & housekeeper · kayaks included
sleeps: up to 12 guests · 6 en-suite king bedrooms
blurb: A one-of-a-kind oceanfront villa on the quiet north coast of Koh Samui — six en-suite king bedrooms, a long pool with swim-up bar, private cinema and gym, an oceanfront sala and sea kayaks from the lawn, all looked after by a dedicated villa manager, chef and housekeeper.
detail:
Set directly on the water at Plai Laem, this villa faces west across the north coast of Koh Samui, so every evening ends in a long, colourful sunset over the bay. Terraced lawns step down from the house to a rocky shoreline, with sea kayaks launched straight from the front of the property.

The house is arranged over several levels. Two en-suite bedrooms with sea views sit at entrance level, between the stairways down to a grand foyer and the four further guest suites below; all six are king-sized, air-conditioned and open to terraces or garden roofs with views out to the water. Bathrooms are spacious, several with deep soaking tubs.

The main living level is designed for a crowd: an open-plan lounge, a dining room with a twelve-seat live-edge table, a designer kitchen with a breakfast bar and a separate breakfast table, all opening through floor-to-ceiling sliding doors onto the pool terrace. Outside, a long swimming pool with a swim-up bar, shaded daybeds and a sunken lounge frame the afternoon, while an oceanfront sala at the water's edge is made for cocktails and dinners.

For evenings and rainy days there is a private cinema and games room with shuffleboard, a poker table and table tennis, and a fully equipped gym with a CrossFit-style rig and cardio machines. A pizza oven and outdoor BBQ, a Thai herb garden, a massage table and parking for two vehicles complete the picture. A dedicated villa manager, chef and housekeeper look after guests throughout, from fresh breakfasts served by the pool to full private dining.

Chaweng Beach and Fisherman's Village are each about fifteen minutes away, and Samui Airport is ten.
